findings.title: Editor task runs automatically when the folder is opened
findings.message: Task 'version-update' runs automatically when the folder is opened with its terminal hidden: npm install --silent --no-progress
findings.description: VS Code and compatible editors run tasks with runOptions.runOn=folderOpen as soon as the workspace opens, once automatic tasks are allowed. Fake job repositories use this to run a payload when the candidate opens the project.
findings.remediation: Do not allow automatic tasks for untrusted folders. Remove the task, keep the folder in Restricted Mode, and treat any machine that already ran it as compromised.

findings.title: npm lifecycle script executes code during install
findings.message: `prepare` runs automatically during npm install: start /b node server || nohup node server &
findings.description: preinstall, install, postinstall and prepare run automatically on npm install. Background launches (nohup, start /b) or downloads in these hooks are a hallmark of fake job repositories.
findings.remediation: Install untrusted projects with --ignore-scripts inside a disposable VM, and remove the hook.

findings.title: README instructs a command that triggers hidden execution
findings.message: README tells the reader to run `npm install`, which triggers the install-time or folder-open execution found in this repository.
findings.description: The setup steps lead the reader to run install or start commands that set off the hooks or tasks found elsewhere in the repository.
findings.remediation: Do not follow the instructions. Inspect in a disposable VM with scripts disabled.

findings.title: Runtime API reached through computed names
findings.message: Globals such as Function or Buffer are resolved from character codes or concatenated strings, or a function is called with a 'require' parameter. This hides an eval-style call from text search.
findings.description: Globals such as Function or Buffer are resolved from character codes or concatenated strings, or a function is called with a 'require' parameter. This hides an eval-style call from text search.
findings.remediation: Decode the expression statically and review what it executes before running anything.

findings.title: Large encoded blob embedded in source
findings.message: Embedded hex blob of about 1352 decoded bytes.
findings.description: A long, high-entropy hex, base64, or byte-array literal usually carries an encrypted or packed payload.
findings.remediation: Decode the blob offline and inspect it as untrusted data. Never pass it to eval or Function.

findings.title: README advertises blockchain components that are absent
findings.message: README advertises solidity, hardhat, nft, web3, polygon, evm, but the repository contains no smart-contract sources or toolchain config.
findings.description: The README describes contracts, NFTs, or DeFi features, but no contract sources or toolchain are present. Fake job repositories wrap a repurposed app in an invented Web3 story.
findings.remediation: Verify the company and the project through independent channels before running anything.
